cards.name: Chrono-Saur Laplace Plesio
cards.audit_note: Applied the user's authoritative ruling that all three effects are hard once per turn. The reported request to remove the third HOPT was rejected; id, id+100, and id+200 remain intact.

coverage_override.reason: Activation/search/lock, destruction-triggered boost, and post-damage destruction are the three ruled HOPT effects.

effects.printed_clause: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Chrono-Saur" card from your Deck to your hand. For the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except Dinosaur monsters. This effect is hard once per turn by user ruling.
effects.lua_implementation: The HOPT activation optionally searches one archetype card, then registers a controller-only non-Dinosaur Special Summon prohibition through the End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Official filtered Deck-to-hand operation uses archetype matching, Duel.SendtoHand, and confirmation.
Official lingering Special Summon restriction uses EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON with an End Phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: If your card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can make your monsters gain 500 ATK/DEF until the end of your Battle Phase. This effect is hard once per turn by user ruling.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed HOPT EVENT_DESTROYED trigger now requires a controller-owned hand/on-field card destroyed for REASON_BATTLE or REASON_EFFECT, then gives all current face-up controlled monsters +500 ATK/DEF through the controller's Battle Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Official EVENT_DESTROYED conditions inspect destruction reason before allowing a delayed trigger.
Official temporary modifiers use a future controller-phase reset structure.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the previous condition accepted every destruction reason, including destruction paid as a cost, despite the text limiting it to battle or card effect.

effects.printed_clause: After damage calculation, if your Dinosaur monster battled an opponent's monster: You can destroy 1 card you control. This effect is hard once per turn by user ruling.
effects.lua_implementation: The field EVENT_BATTLED trigger checks that either battling card is the controller's Dinosaur against an opponent's monster, then destroys one controlled on-field card; SetCountLimit(1,id+200) preserves the ruled HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Official post-battle trigger uses EVENT_BATTLED and inspects the attacker and attack target.
Official distinct hard once-per-turn effects use separate count-limit codes.
